an4.107:1.5: n' eva gādhaṃ khattā no vasitā,
an4.107:1.8: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me musikūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ .
an4.107:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ khattā hoti no vasitā?
an4.107:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:2.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.107:2.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ khattā hoti no vasitā,
an4.107:2.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā gādhaṃ khattā hoti no vasitā,
an4.107:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo vasitā hoti no gādhaṃ khattā?
an4.107:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:3.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.107:3.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo vasitā hoti no gādhaṃ khattā,
an4.107:3.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā vasitā hoti no gādhaṃ khattā,
an4.107:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' eva gādhaṃ khattā hoti no vasitā?
an4.107:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:4.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.107:4.5: Evam kho bhikkhave puggalo n' eva gādhaṃ khattā hoti no vasitā,
an4.107:4.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā n' eva gādhaṃ khattā no vasitā,
an4.107:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ khattā ca hoti vasitā ca?
an4.107:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:5.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.107:5.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ khattā ca hoti vasitā ca,
an4.107:5.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā gādhaṃ khattā ca vasitā ca,
an4.107:5.8: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro mūsikūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 108. 1.
